node: Ecommerce returns, recommerce, reverse logistics, liquidation, and refurbishing infrastructure
summary: Expanded the node around ecommerce returns and reverse-logistics infrastructure with a two-lane funnel. Reference context is represented by UPS because it owns Happy Returns and controls a large consumer drop-off/carrier network. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: Liquidity Services provides surplus/returned/end-of-life asset marketplaces; GXO is a mid-cap contract-logistics operator with explicit ecommerce and reverse-logistics services; Envela is a small-cap recommerce/refurbishment/recycling platform with product-return and IT/electronics lifecycle exposure. The node remains a hypothesis because revenue purity, retailer concentration, take-rate economics, inventory ownership, and working-capital risk must be verified in later layers.
